Generate embeddings with OpenAI API.

**Status:** Can't run yet (Coming soon): the node is listed under **Can't run yet** in the palette and cannot be added to a graph.

Converts text to vector embeddings using OpenAI's embedding models (text-embedding-ada-002).

## Settings

| Setting | Key | Type | Default | Allowed values | Read by | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| api_key | `api_key` | Password | (empty) |   | The run | OpenAI API key. |
| model | `model` | Choice | `text-embedding-ada-002` | `text-embedding-ada-002`, `text-embedding-3-small`, `text-embedding-3-large` | The run | Embedding model. |
| batch_size | `batch_size` | Integer | `100` | `1-10000` | The run | Batch size for API calls. |

**Read by** says whether a run uses the setting (**The run**) or only the editor, a dialog or a view (**The editor only**).

The node runs on the device chosen for the run (CPU or a GPU); a node does not fix a device.
